title: NRO Sentient program integrated with Immaculate Constellation

tellings.quote: the sentient program would have come online to my understanding after like you know immaculate constellation had already existed but would have been integrated with it

plain: A program called Sentient at the National Reconnaissance Office, the US agency that runs spy satellites, is said to have been joined up with Immaculate Constellation, which he describes as a secret effort to gather UFO data. Matthew Brown, a former Pentagon official turned whistleblower, says that to his understanding Sentient came online after Immaculate Constellation already existed and was then integrated with it. If true, it would tie the satellite agency's systems to hidden UFO tracking.
